data.name: Privacy_StaysLocal_Body
data.value: Drive, folder, and file names and paths, file sizes, types and dates, and every scan result stay on this computer. The scan engine reads your file system directly, there is no server involved in analyzing a disk.

data.name: Privacy_OptIn_Body
data.value: If you enable analytics in Settings: that an installation and launches happened, the number of scans performed, the app version, the Windows version, and an approximate country. This is off by default and can be turned off at any time.

data.name: Privacy_NeverCollected_Body
data.value: Your name, email, or Microsoft account. File names, paths, or contents. Folder names or structure. Detailed disk contents. Any identifier used to fingerprint this device. There is no hidden or undocumented telemetry.

data.name: Privacy_Offline_Body
data.value: Free Disk Analyzer works fully offline. Disabling your internet connection does not affect scanning, results, or any core feature.

data.name: Privacy_Affiliate_Body
data.value: The NordVPN card on the Dashboard and the DeleteMe suggestion after a scan are affiliate links, clearly labeled where they appear. Clicking one opens your browser to the partner's site, which then applies its own privacy policy. Free Disk Analyzer does not track which links you click.
